opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK Office
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together across arts, culture, humanities, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth, education and sport. Grants generally £1,500‑£5,000, up to £6,000 in exceptional cases.

opportunities.title: Small Grants – Japan Office
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the Japan office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for collaborative projects between the UK and Japan across a wide range of fields, with typical awards £1,500‑£5,000, up to £6,000 in exceptional cases.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration will also be given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health‑related fields. Preference is given to those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration experience and to early‑career researchers.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, up to £10,000 per year (maximum £30,000 over three years).
